purpose: Teach: 書き込ま/予告編/エンターテインメント/ニックネーム/イコール/号機/点灯/アース
target_vocab: エンターテインメント

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験ノートに細かく書き込まないとな
lines.en: Ren, you need to write down the details in your experimental notebook.
lines.style: Composed, direct. Measured pace. No condescension — this is how things are done. Slight pause before the name, establishing attention before instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の予告編的なポスターを準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare a teaser poster for the paper.
lines.style: Quick intake of breath before the affirmation. Eager but controlled. Thoughtful pause after the acknowledgement, as if already working through the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学術成果もエンターテインメント性を意識しろ
lines.en: Ren, your academic findings need entertainment value too.
lines.style: Steady, slightly firmer. Not harsh — this is experience speaking. Direct eye contact implied. Pause before the core instruction to let it land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室メンバーのニックネームで親しみを作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll use nicknames for the lab members to make it more relatable.
lines.style: Immediate response, not defensive. Slight energy shift — he's grasped the concept. Soft confidence in the proposal, as if testing it aloud to see if it fits.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、相関と因果はイコールではない
lines.en: Ren, correlation and causation aren't the same thing.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. This is a fundamentals check. Warm but serious — a lesson he's making sure sticks. Slight weight on the key phrase.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験装置一号機から五号機まで点検します
lines.en: Yes. I'll inspect experimental units one through five.
lines.style: Obedient tone but not hollow. Quick, precise. The reassurance of someone who takes the point and won't waste time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の照明点灯時間を最適化しろ
lines.en: Ren, optimize the lab's lighting schedule.
lines.style: Brief, matter-of-fact. This is a secondary but important detail. Flat, professional delivery — not dismissive, just practical.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。電子機器のアース処理に気を配ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll be careful with the grounding on the electronic equipment.
lines.style: Focused, closing statement. Quiet precision — he's moved on to the next task. Slight fadeout, as if already mentally in the next room.
